source_lineage.conversion_readme: Case Study L Simulation Triad Experiment README (v1.0)

modulation_mode.description: Models modulation between system-level operational surfaces and manifold structural geometry using bounded structural channels.

gating_mode.description: Applies manifold-level gating across system-manifold interaction surfaces.

cross_surface_alignment_mode.description: Aligns structural flows between system and manifold surfaces without expressive geometry.

stabilization_mode.description: Maintains stable interaction geometry during system-to-manifold transitions.

dissipation_mode.description: Models dissipation of interaction intensity within bounded simulation envelopes.

non_activation_clause.description: This simulation profile is structural-only. It does not activate, simulate, or bind any NDH subsystem, expressive geometry mechanism, holonomy operator, or manifold process.
